rjs_contract: r_JS is the IMU origin position relative to mapped joint J, expressed in joint-local coordinates. World prediction: p_WS(t)=p_WJ(t)+R_WJ(t)@r_JS. For DIP-IMU, tran is not used as trusted global translation; acceleration objectives are diagnostic/self-supervised only.

transform_convention.R_WJ: maps joint-local vectors into world coordinates
transform_convention.R_JS: maps sensor-frame vectors into joint-local coordinates
transform_convention.R_WS: R_WJ @ R_JS, maps sensor-frame vectors into world coordinates
transform_convention.r_JS: IMU sensor origin relative to mapped joint origin, expressed in joint-local coordinates

imu_contract.raw_field_aS: TotalCapture raw accelerometer field in sensor frame; preprocessing stores specific force.
imu_contract.sensor_like_formula: acc_sensor_like = R_WS^T @ (acc_vertex_world - gravity_world), where R_WS = RIM^T @ RIS.

comparison_spaces.sensor_specific_force: compare raw aS to sensor-frame specific force from vertex acceleration.
comparison_spaces.model_world_linear_acc: compare official/reconstructed aM to world/model-frame vertex linear acceleration.

sensor_to_joint_map.coordinate_contract: r_JS is the IMU origin position relative to the mapped joint J, expressed in joint-local coordinates. World prediction: p_WS(t)=p_WJ(t)+R_WJ(t)@r_JS.
